question: DM-INGEST-LEDGER-COMMIT-CONTRACT makes commit terminal only after ledger.transaction.get returns the same immutable facts. Since record returns a populated history projection and get omits it unless includeHistory is true, should the terminal check compare only the frozen immutable facts?
context: Discovered by TASK-INGEST-GATE-INT-LEDGER-CONTRACT (bd-2dg). A whole-payload equality check between the record result and the get result fails on the history member alone; the gate normalizes history out before comparing. The resume/receipt logic in FR-INGEST-DURABLE-RECEIPT-RESUME needs the same rule stated explicitly so it does not treat a healthy commit as unverified.
